loop_status_rule.EARNED_ITS_KEEP: M1 and M9 and M4 all pass.
loop_status_rule.VERIFY_DID_THE_WORK: M1 and M9 pass, M4 fails, and on at least one of {a2, a}: A2 beats A0 by the 5 percent rule AND at least one B2 random seed's held-out accuracy is >= A2's - 0.05 (random proposals through the same FIT+VERIFY came within 5 points).

color_rule: per family x arm, compared with A0 on panel 1: WHITE if every arm in the family is below 0.10 held-out accuracy; GREEN if the arm beats A0 by the 5 percent rule; YELLOW if accuracy higher AND NMAE lower than A0 but not by the rule; RED otherwise (loses, ties, or halts as predicted). A0 itself is REFERENCE.
builder_decisions: INIT/A0 seed uses the bridge v2 bind_table coefficients (witnessed ratio over all train rows, no COEF_BOUNDS; non-positive -> no seed). The program asserts they equal witnessed_ratio_min. COEF_BOUNDS apply to FIT of proposals (ARCHITECTURE s.5.1).
Loop-internal tau decisions evaluate exact coefficients in binary64; reported metrics are exact Fractions.
VERIFY includes ARCHITECTURE s.6.3 'median |ln(y/yhat)| on validation does not rise' (per admission) in addition to the sketch's count rule.

PROPOSE (A3 only): when under-predicted residual exists and the deficit is spread (top cell pressure < 80 percent), a POOLED_LINES proposal is offered: one single-input line per cell plus a capacity stage, fitted by witnessed_pool_solve_v0 (ARCHITECTURE s.5.3: capacity = most repeated exact y with >= S_MIN repeats; lines solved exactly from the first linearly independent unsaturated claimed rows). It REPLACES the Omega's recipe set (claim 3 needs exactly the 4 lines); VERIFY decides like any proposal. Claimed rows = whole residual.

SDG shape library: every recipe seed in seeds.jsonl (sha256 df68d244...) is parsed by sdg_bridge_v2.parse_recipe; attested sizes = core prerequisite counts present (2 and 3). Lookup order: attested sizes ascending, then LOOP_EXTENSION sizes 1 and 4. Every proposal carries a source tag and a library receipt (seed count for its shape).
B2 random: same template space (all 15 cell subsets), P_MAX uniform draws per cycle, same FIT/VERIFY/caps/C_MAX; stops when its draws are all already tried or C_MAX ends.
A0 and B1 get a HALT from the same halt() rule after one READ (no loop), so every arm reports a halt type with carried gaps.

READ row states are cross-checked at every HALT against lacunarity_machine_v1.readers.deterministic_read over a Universe of training rows and a Ledger of PROBE (each READ) and CHARGE (first explained) events.
Panel 2 (chains) is not run (not required by the brief; saves time).
